def f(inp):
    h=len(inp); w=len(inp[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[r[:] for r in inp]
    vline=[c for c in range(w) if all(r[c]==2 for r in inp)]
    hline=[r for r in range(h) if all(x==2 for x in inp[r])]
    cells=[(r,c,vv) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if inp[r][c] not in (bg,2)]
    def move(dr,dc):
        for rr,cc,vv in cells: out[rr][cc]=bg
        for rr,cc,vv in cells: out[rr+dr][cc+dc]=vv
    if vline:
        c=vline[0]; L=min(c for _,c,_ in cells); R=max(c for _,c,_ in cells)
        step = 1 if c>R else -1
        if L*c == -1*0: pass
        if step>0:   # object left of line, moves right
            d = c-1-R
            nrL, nrR = L+d, R+d
        else:         # object right of line
            d = -(L-(c+1))
            nrL, nrR = L+d, R+d
        # far side from line
        el = nrR-1 if step>0 else nrL+1
        move(d,0)
        for rr in range(h): out[rr][el]=8
    elif hline:
        r=hline[0]; T=min(rr for rr,_,_ in cells); B=max(rr for rr,_,_ in cells)
        step = 1 if r>B else -1
        if step>0:    # above line, moves down
            d = r-1-B
            nrT,nrB = T+d, B+d
        else:         # below line
            d = -(T-(r+1))
            nrT,nrB = T+d, B+d
        erow = nrB+1 if step>0 else nrT-1
        move(0,d)
        for cc in range(w): out[erow][cc]=8
    return out
for n in (1,2,3,4):
    print(n, f(G[f'Demo pair {n} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

def load():

    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]

def f(inp):
    h=len(inp); w=len(inp[0])
    bgc=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[r[:] for r in inp]
    vline=[cc for cc in range(w) if all(r[cc]==2 for r in inp)]
    hline=[rr for rr in range(h) if all(x==2 for x in inp[rr])]
    cells=[(rr,cc,inp[rr][cc]) for rr in range(h) for cc in range(w) if inp[rr][cc] not in (bgc,2)]
    def move(dr,dc):
        for rr,cc,vv in cells: out[rr][cc]=bgc; out[rr+dr][cc+dc]=vv
    if vline:
        c=vline[0]; L=min(cc for _,cc,_ in cells); R=max(cc for _,cc,_ in cells)
        if c>R:          # line right of object: slide right to touch it
            d=(c-1)-R; newL=L+d; col=newL-1   # beam immediately left of new bbox
        elif c<L:        # line left of object: slide left to touch it
            d=(c+1)-L; newR=R+d; col=newR+1   # beam immediately right of new bbox
        else:            # flush: no move; beam between object and line
            col = c-1 if c>R else c+1
        move(d,0)
        for rr in range(h): out[rr][col]=8
    else:
        r=hline[0]; T=min(rr for rr,_,_ in cells); B=max(rr for rr,_,_ in cells)
        if r>T:          # line below object: slide down to touch it
            d=(r-1)-B; newT=T+d; row=newT-1   # beam immediately above new bbox
        elif r<B:        # line above object: slide up to touch it
            d=(r+1)-T; newB=B+d; row=newB+1   # beam immediately below new bbox
        else:            # flush
            row = r-1 if r>B else r+1
        move(0,d)
        for cc in range(w): out[row][cc]=8
    return out
